title: A bill to designate the Federal building located at 617 Walnut Street in Helena, Arkansas, as the "Jacob Trieber Federal Building, United States Post Office, and United States Court House".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the federal building located at 617 Walnut Street in Helena, Arkansas, as the "Jacob Trieber Federal Building, United States Post Office, and United States Court House."

summary.headline: A 2015 law renames a federal building in Helena, Arkansas, after former federal judge Jacob Trieber.
summary.what_it_does: The law officially names the federal building at 617 Walnut Street in Helena, Arkansas, the Jacob Trieber Federal Building, United States Post Office, and United States Court House. It changes only the building's name and does not change any rules, services, or funding.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on October 7, 2015.
